payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped SAML 2.0 SP routing. Routes: GET /auth/saml/:id/metadata + POST /auth/saml/:id/acs, reusing the OIDC identity-linking/session path. Enforced validations (all reject->401): XML signature against the CONFIGURED IdP cert (embedded KeyInfo never trusted) + signature-wrapping guard (assertion read for claims must be covered by a verified signature); unsigned rejected; issuer=IdP entityID; AudienceRestriction contains SP entityID; Conditions + SubjectConfirmationData NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter within configurable skew (default 60s); Recipient=ACS URL; InResponseTo=expected AuthnRequest id (SP-initiated); assertion-ID replay protection via new auth_saml_seen_assertions table (SQLite+PG parity). Lib choice: xml-crypto + @xmldom/xmldom (the vetted libs node-saml/passport-saml build on) behind a pluggable SamlSignatureVerifier seam (per-provider override for offline tests). Subject = NameID scoped as providerId:nameId on User.samlSubject; attribute mapping mirrors OIDC claim mapping. Additive/opt-in. Gate green: typecheck 0, server vitest 950 passed/0 failed.
